templates.name: Linux Server Hardening
templates.description: Baseline Linux hardening playbook covering packages, SSH restrictions, and audit settings.
templates.content:
---
- name: Linux hardening baseline
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure latest security packages are installed
      package:
        name: '*'
        state: latest

    - name: Disable root SSH login
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^PermitRootLogin'
        line: 'PermitRootLogin no'

    - name: Restart sshd
      service:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

templates.name: Patch Window Automation
templates.description: Playbook for routine package patching with pre/post checks and service restart controls.
templates.content:
---
- name: Controlled patch window
  hosts: all
  serial: 10
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Gather package facts
      package_facts:

    - name: Apply security updates
      package:
        name: '*'
        state: latest

    - name: Reboot if required
      reboot:
        reboot_timeout: 1800

templates.name: DMZ Firewall Rule Set
templates.description: Example iptables policy for a web-facing DMZ that only permits required inbound and outbound connections.
templates.content:
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.20.0.0/24 --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
COMMIT

templates.name: Management Network ACL Example
templates.description: Example management network policy that restricts administrative access to approved jump hosts and monitoring systems.
templates.content:
# Management segment allow-list
permit tcp 10.50.0.10/32 10.60.0.0/24 eq 22
permit tcp 10.50.0.11/32 10.60.0.0/24 eq 3389
permit udp 10.50.0.20/32 10.60.0.0/24 eq 161
deny ip any 10.60.0.0/24 log
